id.description: lowercase-kebab-case slug of the short title, e.g. 'gpt-3'

shortTitle.description: Short name for the cover, at most ~4 words

authors.description: Surnames, e.g. 'Brown, Mann, Ryder et al.'

aboutAuthors.description: Who they are (affiliations) and why the paper matters, 1-2 sentences

venue.description: Conference or journal as stated in the paper, else 'arXiv'

hook.description: One technical sentence stating what the paper does

whoShouldRead.description: Prerequisite knowledge and what the reader will get

prerequisites.description: ids of papers to read first, chosen only from the known list

insights.description: 5 to 6 key insights in reading order

body.description: 3-6 technical sentences: mechanism, numbers, design choices

formula.description: Optional LaTeX (SwiftMath subset). Separate several lines with '||'

numbers.description: 4 to 7 key facts: sizes, hyperparameters, headline results with units

limitations.description: Weaknesses, caveats, what later work changed

glossary.description: 0 to 6 technical terms used in the text that are not in the known glossary
